stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import os,glob,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); cnt_=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bg=cnt_.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; seen=set()
    def comps_of(pred):
        cs=[]
        for s in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if pred(r,c)]:
            if s in seen: continue
            comp={s}; stack=[s]; seen.add(s)
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop()
                for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and pred(nr,nc) and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); comp.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
            cs.append(comp)
        return cs
    for comp in comps_of(lambda r,c: g[r][c]==0):
        rs=[r for r,c in comp]; cs_=[c for r,c in comp]
        rb,cb=min(rs),min(cs_); reb,ce=max(rs),max(cs_)
        hgt, wgt = reb-rb+1, ce-cb+1
        # pattern built from signal cells adjacent to block top-left corner
        base_r,base_c=rb,cb
        ps=[(r,cc) for r in range(reb,reb+6) for cc in range(ce,ce+6) if g[r][cc]!=bg and g[r][cc]!=0]
        sigset={(r-base_r,c-base_c) for r,cc in ps}
        # dedupe into canonical tile: take bounding box of sig, then extend periodically
        prs=sorted({r for r,c in sigset}); pcs=sorted({c for r,c in sigset})
        ph=max(prs)-prs[0]+1; pw=max(pcs)-pcs[0]+1
        # map sig onto tile coords relative to prs[0],pcs[0]
        P=[[False]*pw for _ in range(ph)]
        for rr,cc in sigset: P[rr-prs[0]][cc-pcs[0]]=True
        col=None
        votes={}
        for r,c in ps: votes[g[r][c]]=votes.get(g[r][c],0)+1
        for v,n in votes.items(): if v!=bg and v!=0: col=v
        for dr in range(hgt):
            for dc in range(wgt):
                i,j=(dr)%ph,(dc)%pw
                if P[i][j] and (not keep or g[rb+dr][cb+dc] != col):
                    out[rb+dr][cb+dc]=col
        return out
